status_detail: Morgan County EDC's project site says Google is set to break ground in 2026. County PUD materials and local reporting describe rezoning for a large data-center campus near Monrovia; AES Indiana says it filed with IURC on April 22, 2026 to serve Google's proposed Monrovia data center, with regulatory approval expected before infrastructure proceeds.
notes: Official local project site confirms Google and 2026 groundbreaking; 390 MW is from reviewed tracker/regulatory-reporting summaries of AES Indiana's HEA 1007/IURC filing rather than the county project site itself. Local reporting says Google had 628 acres after additional purchases/rezoning; earlier PUD record covers the initial 391-acre project area.
